title: xDrip+ update mechanism does not work
symptom: User on nightly 2019-12-31 (alpha channel + auto update check enabled) reports not receiving any update notifications and manually selecting 'Check for updated version' only shows 'Checking for update...' for 3 seconds then disappears with no effect.
fix: Ensure the nightly channel is selected, as suggested by maintainer jamorham. User later confirmed update works.
evidence_quote: Make sure you have the nightly channel selected: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/wiki/How-to-get-the-Nightlies-on-Automatic-Update
